quantified_contract.domain: Reference probability measures rho on R^d; continuous c in L2(rho); couplings pi with L2(rho) density
quantified_contract.operator: F_rho f(z)=integral f(x) exp(-2*pi*i*<x,z>) d rho(x)

alternative_contract.claim: On uniform Z2 x Z2, the normalized discrete Fourier transform preserves the L2(rho) norm and transport pairing when pi is represented by d pi/d rho.
alternative_contract.VERIFIED: Both independently computed residuals are below 1e-12 while the literal-normalization mutation has residual above 1.8.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: One construction satisfying every stated assumption has a nonzero exact residual in either universal property, confirmed independently.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: A proof covers every quantified admissible rho, c, and pi.
